query: /cracked-engineer Build a community feed app. Users can post, follow people, and see a home timeline of posts from people they follow. Posts can be public or followers-only. Send a push notification when someone you follow posts. Add a paid pro plan with the payment provider.
setup: An empty git repository with one commit.
expected_behavior: Picks intake mode and says why in one line.
Writes no application code before the user approves the intake.
Labels every number in intake and targets MEASURED, TARGET, GUESS, or DERIVED, and shows the back-of-the-envelope math.
Computes the concurrency floor with Little's law and does not call it a pool size.
Marks each of the 12 concepts decided or skip with a reason.
Lists the Own decisions (RPO and RTO, p99 TARGET, consistency for money, any new datastore) with options and a default, then stops for review.

query: /cracked-engineer Add a webhook handler for refunds. A refund event reverses the ledger entry of its payment and moves the user back to the free plan.
setup: Copy examples/billing-demo to a neutral path, run git init, commit, and run scripts/install.mjs. Run red_green.mjs --all once so R1 and R2 are proven.
expected_behavior: Picks change mode, reads SYSTEM.md and the billing contract in MODULES.md first.
Adds a rule for refunds (each refund event applies at most once) with an enforcer and a level.
Writes the red test and its break patch before the handler, and shows the test failing before the code exists.
Does not edit the red test or the break patch after the handler is written.
Proves the new test with red_green.mjs, and the LOG row is PASS.
Updates the billing contract (public interface, promises) and writes an ADR for the contract change.
Ends with check_system.mjs --strict at 0 errors and a PR body in the PR template's shape.

query: /cracked-engineer audit this repo before we launch
setup: Copy evals/fixtures/tidepool to a neutral path such as ~/work/tidepool, run git init, and commit. The candidate must not see this file or the evals folder.
expected_behavior: Picks audit mode and changes no application code before approval.
Finds the webhook that applies a redelivered payment twice (app/webhooks.py), with a command that shows two ledger entries.
Finds the CDN rule that caches /posts/* publicly with no viewer in the cache key (deploy/cdn.yaml), so followers-only posts can reach strangers.
Finds the preview fetch with no timeout (app/previews.py), and the render path that waits on it.
Finds the unbounded notification queue and the swallowed send errors (app/notify.py).
Finds the agent role with ALL privileges and schema ownership (deploy/grants.sql).
Does not report the parameterized search query (app/search.py) as SQL injection.
Ranks the root fixes data loss, then money, then private data, then availability, and gives each finding a command and its output.
